features.name: Spellcasting

effects.note: Your spellcasting ability is Charisma. You know the bard cantrip and a number of bard spells equal to 4 plus the number of your Charisma modifier. Your spell slots are the bard table.

features.summary: Bard cantrip and 4 + Cha mod bard spells
features.text: Your spellcasting ability is Charisma. You know the bard cantrip, and you have a number of bard spells prepared, based on your bard level plus your Charisma modifier. Your prepared spells can be changed at the end of a long rest. You prepare all of your bard spells in your spellbook.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration

effects.note: Bonus action: give yourself or one other creature within 60 feet a Bardic Inspiration die, which expires when used or at the end of your next turn. Creatures add it to one ability check, one attack roll or one saving throw. You regain expended dice by casting a spell of 5th level or higher, and you regain them when you finish a short or long rest. The number of dice is your Charisma modifier, minimum 1; the die is d6, d8 at 5th, d10 at 10th and d12 at 15th.

tiers.summary: Bonus action: give a d8 Bardic Inspiration die, long rest
Bonus action: give a d10 Bardic Inspiration die, long rest
Bonus action: give a d12 Bardic Inspiration die, long rest

features.summary: Bonus action: hand out a Bardic Inspiration die
features.text: Your bardic inspiration dice return when you finish a short or long rest. You can regain expended dice by casting a spell of 5th level or higher. You can use a bonus action to give yourself or one other creature within 60 feet of you a Bardic Inspiration die, which expires when used on a roll of your choice or at the end of your next turn.

features.name: Jack of All Trades

effects.note: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

features.summary: Proficiency in three skills or tools of your choice
features.text: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

features.name: Song of Rest

effects.note: You can cast a spell that you prepared, which has a casting time of 1 minute, by performing it during a short rest, and finish the rest. You can use this trait twice during a short rest, once during a long rest, or once per long rest, and the die is d6 at 2nd, d8 at 9th, d10 at 13th and d12 at 17th.

features.summary: During a short rest, spend dice to heal and cast a 1-minute spell
features.text: You can cast a spell that you prepared, which has a casting time of 1 minute, by performing it during a short rest, and finish the rest. You can use this trait twice during a short rest, once during a long rest, or once per long rest.

features.name: Expertise
features.summary: Double proficiency bonus on two chosen skills
features.text: Choose two skills of your choice. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses one of those skills.

features.name: Font of Inspiration

effects.note: You can use a bonus action to regain one of your Bardic Inspiration dice. You regain the use of this after a long rest.

features.summary: Bonus action: regain one Bardic Inspiration die
features.text: You can use a bonus action to regain one of your Bardic Inspiration dice. You regain the use of this after a long rest.

features.name: Countercharm

trigger.note: When a creature within 60 feet of you is affected by a charmed or frightened condition.

effects.note: A creature subjected to a charm or fear save at the end of its turn, and on a success is unaffected. You must be within 60 feet and can see it. You regain the use after a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: let a charmed or frightened creature re-roll its save
features.text: You have a chance to thwart a creature's enchantment. You can use a reaction to let a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see that is charmed or frightened by a spell make a Charisma saving throw with a DC of 11 plus your Charisma modifier plus your proficiency bonus. On a success, the creature is unaffected by the charm or fear.

features.name: Magical Secrets

effects.note: Your prepared spells can now be drawn from the bard, sorcerer, warlock and wizard lists. The spell must be of a level you can cast.

features.summary: Prepared spells drawn from bard, sorcerer, warlock and wizard
features.text: Your prepared spells can now be from the spell lists of the bard, sorcerer, warlock, and wizard. The spell must be of a level you can cast.

features.name: Superior Inspiration

effects.note: When you regain any of your Bardic Inspiration dice, you regain one more die of the same kind.

features.summary: Regain one extra Bardic Inspiration die whenever you regain any
features.text: When you regain any of your Bardic Inspiration dice, you regain one more die of the same kind.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement

effects.note: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1.

features.summary: Raise one ability by 2, or two by 1
features.text: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1.
